おもったら.es: si pensé; cuando creí (de おもう)
おもったら.en: If I thought; when I believed (from)

ねられなかった.es: no pude dormir (de ねられる)

texto: To say that something you thought was going to happen, but something else happened: phrase + **か と おもったら**: **やっと ねた か と おもったら、 もう あさ でした** (just when I thought I had finally fallen asleep, it was already day).
It is followed by the surprise or the result.
It's used to count an unexpected turn.
It usually has a tone of surprise or humor.
